pmmSummary.zh: 面向北美市场，把 QiCore 的产品与系统能力转化为清晰的价值主张，并用数据驱动的投放测试完成从 MVP 验证到上市推广的营销闭环。

pmmResponsibility1.zh: 深入开展海外市场调研，分析目标用户需求、真实使用场景、竞品卖点及圈层渠道生态，为产品定位与差异化切入点提供数据与洞察支撑。
pmmResponsibility1.en: Run in-depth overseas market research on target user needs, real usage scenarios, competitor selling points, and community and channel ecosystems, providing data and insight for positioning and differentiation.

pmmResponsibility2.zh: 充分理解产品及系统能力，结合北美市场特点，将技术语言转化为对用户有吸引力的产品价值主张，独立搭建 FABE、Message House 等核心营销框架。
pmmResponsibility2.en: Understand the product and system capabilities deeply, translate technical language into value propositions that resonate with North American users, and independently build core frameworks such as FABE and Message House.

pmmResponsibility3.zh: 撰写并维护全套英文产品营销资料（产品手册、规格表、用户指南等），输出 Experience Guide、KOL Brief 等关键营销材料，统一对外产品叙事口径。
pmmResponsibility3.en: Write and maintain the full set of English product marketing materials (brochures, spec sheets, user guides), produce key assets such as Experience Guides and KOL Briefs, and keep the external product narrative consistent.

pmmResponsibility4.zh: 运用增长营销思维，主导 Meta、Reddit、Google 等核心渠道的冷启动与广告测试；通过受众、文案和素材的 A/B 测试监控 CTR、CPL、ROI 等指标，以数据闭环驱动卖点表达的持续迭代。
pmmResponsibility4.en: Apply a growth marketing mindset to lead cold starts and ad testing on core channels such as Meta, Reddit, and Google; A/B test audiences, copy, and creatives while tracking CTR, CPL, and ROI, closing the data loop to keep refining how selling points are expressed.

pmmResponsibility5.zh: 从产品全生命周期视角出发，结合不同阶段的业务目标，制定并调整产品营销策略与内容，协同团队高效推进从 MVP 验证到上市推广的营销衔接。
pmmResponsibility5.en: Take a full product lifecycle view, set and adjust product marketing strategy and content for each stage's business goals, and work with the team to move smoothly from MVP validation to launch.

pmmRequirement2.en: Solid product marketing methodology, able to independently build frameworks such as Message House and FABE, with excellent skills in translating technical language and writing English content.

pmmRequirement3.zh: 具备扎实的市场调研能力，能针对产品独立开展海外用户研究与竞品分析，并输出高质量调研报告。
pmmRequirement3.en: Strong market research skills, able to independently run overseas user research and competitor analysis for a product and deliver high-quality research reports.

pmmRequirement4.zh: 熟悉Meta、Reddit、Google等平台广告投放与测试逻辑，对数据敏感，能够依托数据结论迭代营销卖点与内容。
pmmRequirement4.en: Familiar with ad buying and testing on platforms such as Meta, Reddit, and Google; data-sensitive and able to iterate selling points and content based on what the data shows.

pmmRequirement5.zh: 逻辑清晰，做事闭环，拥有项目 Owner 意识；能主动洞察市场变化，高效协同研发、产品、市场等多部门推动产品策略落地。
pmmRequirement5.en: Clear thinking, follows work through to completion, and has a project-owner mindset; proactively spots market changes and works efficiently with R&D, product, and marketing teams to put product strategy into practice.

genpiThoughtIntent.zh: 用户想要一架飞机，而且搭好之后要真的能起飞，所以结构和起飞都得一起规划。
genpiThoughtIntent.en: They want a plane that actually flies once it's built, so the structure and the takeoff have to be planned together.

genpiThoughtStructure.zh: 先用方块垒出机身当骨架，主翼、驾驶舱、发动机、尾翼、螺旋桨、起落架和航灯依次挂上去：共 {steps} 个步骤、{modules} 个模块。
genpiThoughtStructure.en: Blocks first, to make the fuselage the spine; wings, cockpit, engines, tail, propeller, landing gear and lights attach to it in turn: {steps} steps, {modules} modules.

genpiThoughtMaterials.zh: 主翼和水平尾翼用长板，驾驶舱和舷窗用玻璃；两台动力舱左右对称挂在主翼下方，让重心落在主翼附近。
genpiThoughtMaterials.en: Planks for the wings and tailplane, glass for the canopy and windows; two engines hang symmetrically under the wings to keep the balance point near the wing.

genpiThoughtGear.zh: 起落架：两个主轮在主翼下方，前轮靠近机头，滑跑时机身才能保持水平。
genpiThoughtGear.en: Landing gear: two main wheels under the wings and a nose wheel up front, so the fuselage stays level on the takeoff roll.

genpiThoughtTakeoff.zh: 规划起飞：跑道航向 {heading}°，启动引擎 → 滑跑加速 → 抬头离地 → 收起落架 → 爬升。
genpiThoughtTakeoff.en: Takeoff: runway {heading}°, engine start → takeoff roll → liftoff → gear up → climb.

aPrototypeUsedToMeanSchematicsPart.zh: 以前做原型要画原理图、选器件、焊板子。现在把想法拖进工作台，AI 写控制程序、仿真跑通，周末就能把东西做出来。
aPrototypeUsedToMeanSchematicsPart.en: A prototype used to mean schematics, part picking and soldering. Now I drop the idea into the workspace, AI writes the control code, the simulation clears, and it exists by the weekend.

theBiggestChangeInClassIsThat.zh: 课堂上最明显的变化，是学生不再卡在电路和代码上。他们把时间花在“我想让这个机器人做什么”，而不是“为什么它不亮”。
theBiggestChangeInClassIsThat.en: The biggest change in class is that students stop getting stuck on circuits and code. Their time goes to “what should this robot do”, not “why won't it light up”.

theOneToOneMatchBetweenVirtual.zh: 虚拟模块和实体模块一一对应这点太关键了。我先在屏幕里把动作调顺，再一键下载到实体模块，装进壳里就能跑，几乎没有落差。
theOneToOneMatchBetweenVirtual.en: The one-to-one match between virtual and physical blocks is the key. I tune the motion on screen, download it to the real block, snap it into a shell, and it runs.

whatINeedToValidateIsInteraction.zh: 我需要验证的是交互和结构，而不是电子。设计完直接导出 3D 模型打印外壳，和电子模块拼在一起，第二天就能拿到拿在手上的版本。
whatINeedToValidateIsInteraction.en: What I need to validate is interaction and form, not electronics. I export the 3D shell, print it, snap the blocks in, and hold a real version the next day.

iterationSpeedIsTheWinIfIt.zh: 最省时间的是试错。方案在仿真里跑通了再动手，材料基本不浪费，迭代从“一周一次”变成“一天几次”。
iterationSpeedIsTheWinIfIt.en: Iteration speed is the win. If it clears in simulation before I build, I waste almost no material, and my loop goes from once a week to several times a day.

theBlocksCanBeErasedAndRecombined.zh: 模块可以反复擦写、重新组合，空间里的物料周转率高了很多。同一批模块，这个月做灯，下个月做小车，孩子们很买账。
theBlocksCanBeErasedAndRecombined.en: The blocks can be erased and recombined, so our materials turn over much faster. The same set becomes a lamp this month and a rover next month. The kids love it.
